items.title: Volkswagen Taigun sells 100,000 units in India and 52,751 overseas since launch
items.summary: The Volkswagen Taigun, which turned five years old last month after its launch in September 2021 , has surpassed the 100,000-units domestic market sales milestone. As per SIAM wholesales numbers, the midsize SUV has sold 99,095 units till end-September 2026.
